title: Final Adversarial PR-Worthiness Audit
scope: Read-only contribution gate; no upstream or GitHub mutations

live_baseline.pages: Previously deployed; not changed in this phase

key_conclusions.fact: The fork contains a substantial read-only stdio implementation and real-process tests.
key_conclusions.interpretation: It is not contribution-ready because the implementation does not enforce required modern per-request metadata and accepts null request IDs, while issue #219 describes a broader curated read/write surface than the eight read-only tools implemented.

key_conclusions.fact: PR #393 is open and proposes a loopback-guarded POST /__ix/remap endpoint plus WSL bootstrap changes.
key_conclusions.interpretation: The feature is valuable, but client-disconnect cleanup calls child.kill rather than guaranteed process-tree cleanup, and concurrency/rate behavior is not bounded despite the endpoint executing a privileged map. Re-review is required before promotion.

key_conclusions.fact: Current upstream main registers patches and contains the version-series and IX_HOME staging fixes.
key_conclusions.interpretation: F-008/F-009 and related Phase 3 candidates must not be proposed as new upstream work.

key_conclusions.fact: Ix-findings has a previously deployed sanitized Pages projection.
key_conclusions.interpretation: It is an investigation deliverable, not an Ix upstream contribution; its snapshot is explicitly not live GitHub state.

important_history_discrepancy.fact: PR #393's public conversation still contains the old Codebuff footer in previously posted text.
important_history_discrepancy.impact: Local commit hooks and rewritten commit messages do not remove already-published PR conversation history.
important_history_discrepancy.action: Record only; no deletion or comment mutation performed because prohibited by this phase.

limitations: The shell runner failed to spawn bash during final local validation, so no commit or push was executed.
No local source mutation was performed during this audit.
The current live baseline is established from live GitHub pages/raw source plus existing Phase 14 evidence; inaccessible private Compass source remains blocked.
